name: setup-manaflow-ai-t3code-profile
description: The thread workspace look with every feature look's settings, the app's keyboard flows (Command-K palette, Command-J terminal, Command-D diff, Shift-Command-M/E/A composer chords) and its instant panels.

files.themes/t3code-workspace.json:
{
  "name": "Thread workspace",
  "description": "Black conversation canvas with a quiet sidebar and compact project rows.",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "density": {
    "basedOn": "compact",
    "tokens": {
      "sidebarWidth": 256,
      "sidebarRowHeight": 36,
      "sidebarRowHeightWithSubtitle": 60,
      "sidebarCornerRadius": 6,
      "sidebarRowGap": 1
    }
  },
  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#000000",
    "foreground": "#f5f5f5",
    "accent": "#c4b5fd",
    "selection": "#282828"
  }
}
